subject: Microglial Waste Clearance: The Shared Cellular Pathway Behind Childhood Dementia and Alzheimer's
script: From Agewell Brief: Microglial Waste Clearance: The Shared Cellular Pathway Behind Childhood Dementia and Alzheimer's. New research reveals how the brain's immune cells respond to toxic buildup, linking a rare pediatric disorder to Alzheimer's through a common mechanism of failed phagocytosis. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
